NATIONAL DISASTER MANAGEMENT
NATIONAL DISASTER
MANAGEMENT
ORDINANCE, 2007
(Application of
amendments specified in the Scheduled
to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part-II,
19th March, 2008]
S.R.O. 302(I)/2008, dated 10-3-2008.--In
exercise of the powers conferred by clause (3) of Article 247 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to
direct that the National Disaster Management Ordinance, 2007 (LIII of 2007)
shall subject to the amendment specified in the scheduled below, apply to the
Federally Administered Tribal Areas:--
SCHEDULE
1. In section 2,--
(i) after clause (a), the following new clauses shall be
inserted, namely:--
(aa)
"Agency Authority" means the Agency Disaster Management Authority
established under section 18A;
(ab)
"Agency or TR" means any Agency or Tribal Area as defined in clause
(c) of Article 246 of the Constitution of Islamic Republic of Pakistan,
including the Tribal Area adjoining Lakki Marwat District;
(ac)
"Agency Plan" means a Disaster Management Plan prepared for a
particular Agency under section 21A; and
(ii) after
clause (e), the following new clauses shall be inserted, namely:--
(ea)
"FATA" means the Federally Administered Tribal Areas;
(eb)
"FATA Authority" means the Federally Administered Tribal Areas
Disaster Management Authority
established under section 15A;
(ec)
"FATA Commission" means the Federally Administered Tribal Areas
Disaster Management Commission
established under section 13A;
(ed) "FATA
Plan" means the plan for disaster management for Federally Administered
Tribal Areas prepared under section 17A;".
2. In section 6, in subsection (2), in clause
(d), for the words "Provincial Authorities", the words "the
Federally Administered Tribal Areas Authorities" shall be substituted.
3. In section (9),--
(i) in clause (d) for the words "Provincial
Authorities" the words "Federally Administered Tribal Areas
Authorities"; and
(ii) in clauses
(e) and (g) for the words "Provincial Governments and the Provincial
Authorities" the words "Federally Administered Tribal Areas
Authorities" shall be substituted.
4. In Chapter-III, in the title for the words
"Provincial" the word "Federally Administered Tribal Areas"
shall be substituted;
5. After section 13. the following new section shall be inserted, namely:--
'13A. Establishment of FATA
Commission.-(1) The Federal Government shall, as soon as may be after the
issuance of the notification under subsection (1) of section 3, establish a
Federally Administered Tribal Area Disaster Management Commission for the
Federally Administered Tribal Area.
(2) The FATA Commission shall consist of
the following, namely:--
(a) The Governor, North-West
Frontier Province, who shall be Chairperson, ex officio:
(b) Chief Secretary, North-West
Frontier Province;
(c) Additional Chief Secretary (FATA);
(d) Secretary (Law and Order), FATA
Secretariat;
(e) Secretary (Planning and Development),
FATA Secretariat;
(f) Secretary Finance, FATA Secretariat;
(g) one FATA
MNA to be
nominated by the
Governor N.-W.F.P.;
(h) one
FATA Senator to
be nominated by
the Governor N.-W.F.P.;
(i)
Director-General Media (FATA), FATA Secretariat;
(j) Chief Engineer (FATA), Works and
Services Department;
(k) Director Health Services (FATA), FATA
Secretariat;
(1) Director Education (FATA), FATA
Secretariat;
(m) Director Irrigation and Hydle Power (FATA), FATA Secretariat;
(n) Director Local Government and Rural
Development (FATA Civil Secretariat (FATA);
(o) Deputy Director, Technical Education
(FATA), FATA Secretariat;
(p) Conservator of Forests (FATA), FATA
Secretariat;
(q) Director (Livestock and Dairy
Development FATA), FATA Secretariat;
(r) Other members to be nominated by
Governor N.-W.F.P.; and
(s) The Chairperson of the FATA
Commission may designate one of the members specified in clauses (b) to (r) to
be the Vice-Chairperson."
